findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/CFSGStatement/README.md:428–444` defines this candidate specifically as milestone L3, while `fixedSubgroup` itself depends only on an arbitrary group endomorphism; the existing CFSG topic directory contains `Closure.lean`, `Index.lean`, and `SuzukiRee.lean`.
findings.fix: Move the generic fixed-subgroup declarations to a dedicated `GroupTheory/FixedSubgroup.lean`, and move `FixedPointCandidate` plus its two supporting results to `GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/CFSG/FixedPointCandidate.lean`, importing the two generic construction modules there.
findings.issue: The file mixes the independent, broadly reusable `fixedSubgroup` API (lines 254–309) and the roadmap-specific `FixedPointCandidate` API (lines 311–337) into a module named only for derived central quotients, obscuring both APIs and coupling fixed subgroups to unrelated quotient/cardinality/simple-group imports.

summary: The fixed-point API and CFSG candidate construction are misplaced in the generic derived-central-quotient module.
